incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-7421 
incident-bot: symptoms=errors on model-resolve API, 5xx spike, catalog lookup failures for model 'rwdx/gamma-3b'
incident-bot: severity=high, auto-escalate in 5m if unack'd

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-INC-7421 assigned to oncall (maya singh).

maya singh: ack'd — looking now. can someone grab traffic/metrics? :eyes:

raj patel: grabbing logs, seeing a bunch of 502s from catalog service -> model-config service. stack traces show tokenizer mismatch errors during model variant resolution.

liz moreno: CS FYI — we have two enterprise customers (acme-corp EU, mallory-fin) reporting generation failures and degraded latency. they opened support tickets ~5m ago.

maya singh: good to know. Raj, can you paste an example error?

raj patel: ```
ERROR model-resolver: failed to load tokenizer for model rwdx/gamma-3b@rev=2026-03-11T23:12:45Z
reason: vocab encoding mismatch: expected byte-level BPE, got sentencepiece (spm)
trace: catalogs/loader.go:142
```

tom wu: that revision (2026-03-11...) was promoted from staging earlier today with a packaging change to tokenizer artifacts. looks like the catalog metadata incorrectly flagged it as compatible with the previous runtime.

maya singh: ok — hypothesis: catalog promotion pushed a revision whose tokenizer type differs from the pinned runtime variant causing resolver to error out. fallback logic should pick compatible variant but seems to be short-circuited by bad defaults.

sre-runbook-bot: Runbook: model-catalog-tokenizer-mismatch -> mitigation step 1: pin traffic to previous revision; step 2: rollback faulty catalog entry; step 3: if rollback fails, enable emergency fallback to compatibility layer. Link: https://redwood.runbooks/runbooks/model-catalog-tokenizer-mismatch

maya singh: Raj/Tom, can you try pinning the route to the last-known-good rev (2026-03-10T18:07:02Z) for rwdx/gamma-3b? I want minimal change first.

raj patel: running pin now.

raj patel: ```
# pin model route to previous rev
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/catalog/routes/pin' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"model":"rwdx/gamma-3b","revision":"2026-03-10T18:07:02Z"}'
```

raj patel: pinned. registry reports active rev=2026-03-10T18:07:02Z across us/eu. rolling config out to edge nodes.

maya singh: checking prod metrics... 5xxs dropping. latency improving. Liz, can you confirm with CS whether acme/mallory see recovery?

liz moreno: acme confirms recovery, mallory still seeing intermittent fails but their requests appear to route to a different region. escalating to their account engineer to validate.

tom wu: I'll open a promotion audit. Early evidence: the promotion job omitted the tokenizer_type field in metadata, defaulted to 'auto' which our resolver treated as 'previous', but the new artifact was spm. So mismatch.

maya singh: root cause looks like catalog metadata omission + bad defaulting behavior in resolver. Impact: short window of failed model resolutions (~8 mins) affecting tokenization-sensitive routes; some clients got 5xx / truncated outputs.

raj patel: filing quick revert to remove the bad revision from catalog to prevent future auto-rollouts.

raj patel: ```
# remove bad rev from catalog index
python -m rwd.catalog remove-revision --model rwdx/gamma-3b --rev 2026-03-11T23:12:45Z --force --reason "tokenizer mismatch"
```

tom wu: also adding a validation to promotion pipeline to ensure tokenizer_type explicitness and to run a quick compatibility check. I'll pair with build team.

maya singh: escalation note: no data exfiltration or security impact. Customer impact limited to degraded inference. Estimated affected requests ~27k in the window. No SLA breach expected but mark incident for postmortem.

liz moreno: I'll follow up with accounts and draft customer-facing summary. Suggested message: we experienced model resolution failures after a catalog promotion; we've reverted and pinned to a safe revision; we expect normal behavior.

sre-runbook-bot: Suggest next steps: create postmortem, assign owners (tom for fix in promotion pipeline, raj for catalog removal verification, maya for incident writeup), schedule 1-hour follow-up.

maya singh: assigning owners now. Tom — pipeline validation. Raj — confirm catalog cleanup + add monitoring alert to catch tokenizer-type drift. Liz — customer comms. I'll run the postmortem doc.

raj patel: catalog removed and propagated. added alert: catalog.metadata.tokenizer_type == null -> fire warning.

maya singh: handing off to night oncall (tom wu). I'm going offline in 20m, but leaving notes in incident doc. If PD re-fires, escalate to SRE lead.

tom wu: ack'd. I'll monitor the alert and follow up tomorrow for the postmortem. ping me if anything re-fires. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident PD-INC-7421 acknowledged by maya singh, status=mitigated, time_to_ack=00:01:12, time_to_mitigate=00:08:20

maya singh: closing thread here, starting postmortem draft. thanks team. :pray:
